database.name: HefnoPlant Fungicides Active Ingredients Database
database.description: Scientific database of agricultural fungicide active ingredients, classified by FRAC mode-of-action groups, with target fungal-disease and crop relationships, resistance cross-reactivity, and ready-made rotation spray programs.
